room_rent.note: Base: Actuals up to SI, any room. Optional Room Rent Type Option can restrict to Single Private A/C or Shared (premium-saver)

icu.note: ICU covered at actuals up to Sum Insured

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base hospitalisation; 20% co-pay only on OPD reimbursement; non-network delay/biopsy co-pay 10-20%

sub_limits.note: Modern treatments, AYUSH, organ donor, mental illness, obesity all at actuals up to SI

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting 2 years per Product Benefit Table; reducible to 1 year via optional cover

specific_disease_waiting.note: Reducible to 1 year via optional cover

maternity.note: Worldwide Yuva Maternity Cover optional; waiting 3/2/1 yr options; covers IVF/IUI/ICSI, egg freezing, global delivery, adoption support

cumulative_bonus.note: Yuva Credit: +100% of Base SI per renewal year up to 1000% (10X in 10 years); not applicable with Unlimited SI option

restoration.note: Yuva Reload: 2X cover from day 1 on first claim, unlimited refill up to Base SI for subsequent claims; min 24h hospitalisation

ambulance.note: Domestic Road & Air Ambulance, actuals up to Sum Insured

modern_treatments.note: Modern procedures/treatments at actuals up to SI for listed procedures

consumables.note: Claim Protect: non-medical/non-payable items covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)

global_cover.note: Worldwide maternity via optional Yuva Maternity Cover; base hospitalisation domestic

grace_period.note: VERIFY: grace period as per IRDAI / Policy Schedule

notable_exclusions.display: Standard IRDAI exclusions (Excl01-18); maternity & global only via optional cover; Yuva Credit/Reload void if Unlimited SI opted

optional_riders.display: Worldwide Yuva Maternity, Newborn Cover, OPD Cover, PED/Specific waiting reduction, Room Rent Type, Durable Equipment, Income Protect, FitForward Premium
